title: Reachability
description: Whether the target poses lie inside the arm's reachable workspace. Recorded facts — Factor: Reachability; Estimated by: workspace query; Threshold: all key poses. Used by task planners and fleet managers to accept only tasks likely to succeed.
demo:
# Reachability — runnable demo (python3)
# Reachability - feasibility score (python3)
scores=[0.9, 0.85, 0.95]
avg=sum(scores)/len(scores)
print("factor scores:", scores, "avg=%.2f" % avg)
print("FEASIBLE" if avg >= 0.7 and min(scores) >= 0.4 else "NOT FEASIBLE")
